literal.prompt: Какой из этих обитателей Антарктики служит важной пищей для многих китов, тюленей и пингвинов?

literalGroups.primaryGround: The repaired stem asks about food-web role, not biological class. AAP says krill provides meals for scale fish, cephalopods such as squid, penguins, some seal species and baleen whales (L312); nearly everything in Antarctica eats krill, including fish, squid and seabirds (L330-L332). The fish page places Antarctic silverfish and icefish in Antarctic fish context (L299-L304). All four options are Antarctic marine animals and plausible food-web candidates; only krill matches the broad, central prey role stated in the stem.
literalGroups.locator: AAP Antarctic food web full retained body L308-L334; especially L312-L313 and L330-L332.

literalGroups.literal: Антарктический криль питается фитопланктоном, а сам служит пищей для рыб, кальмаров, пингвинов, некоторых тюленей и усатых китов. Так он связывает микроскопические растения с крупными животными пищевой сети.
literalGroups.primaryGround: AAP states phytoplankton feeds krill (L310, L326), while krill feeds fish, squid, penguins, some seals and baleen whales (L312, L330-L332). Both sentences remain supported and directly name/explain the key.
literalGroups.locator: AAP Antarctic food web full retained body L308-L334; especially L312-L313 and L330-L332.

literalGroups.literal: Кальмары — головоногие; ими питаются многие виды в Антарктике.
literalGroups.primaryGround: AAP calls squid a cephalopod (L312) and says it is a favourite meal for many Antarctic species (L313). This grounds the distractor note without making its taxonomy a clue in the stem.
literalGroups.locator: AAP Antarctic food web full retained body L308-L334; especially L312-L313 and L330-L332.

literalGroups.literal: Антарктическая серебрянка — рыба Южного океана, а не ракообразное.
literalGroups.primaryGround: AAP identifies Antarctic silverfish on its Antarctic fish page (L297-L301). The note is a direct identification of this option and its fish category.
literalGroups.locator: AAP Antarctic fish full retained body L297-L313; especially L299-L301 and L309-L310.

literalGroups.literal: Ледяные рыбы приспособлены к холодной воде и занимают заметное место в пищевой сети Южного океана.
literalGroups.primaryGround: AAP says Antarctic fish are adapted to cold (L299) and icefish eat plankton and small fish and feed seabirds, seals and large fish (L309-L310). This is a concrete fact about the icefish option.
literalGroups.locator: AAP Antarctic fish full retained body L297-L313; especially L299-L301 and L309-L310.

literalGroups.literal: Антарктический криль — небольшое ракообразное; взрослая особь достигает около 6 см и весит более 1 г.
literalGroups.primaryGround: AAP identifies krill as Antarctic food-web prey (L326, L332) and says adult Antarctic krill are approximately 6 cm and weigh over one gram (L327). This note adds a distinct size/weight fact beyond the repaired stem and key.
